motionReport.geometryPolicy: Original source meshes, material slots, modifiers and parenting retained; object matrices only.
motionReport.seekPolicy: Absolute source matrices at every seek; exact original matrices at progress zero.
motionReport.motion: The complete assembled Telecaster makes one constant-speed 360-degree rotation about its own vertical centerline.
motionReport.floorMinimumMethod: A rotation about scene Z preserves every source vertex height.
motionReport.endpointPolicy: Progress 0 and 1 both assign the exact saved source matrices; no numerical sin(2*pi) residual.

presentation.cameraPolicy: Keep the source camera position/direction; use one fixed orthographic scale fitted across all 121 poses.

limitations: Sampled source poses; interpolation does not imply measured engineering time.
